desc.en: A red crystal used as the basis for gunpowder. Its flammability is so high, simply rubbing them together produces sparks. It would be dangerous in the hands of children.
desc.ja: 火薬の元としても使われる赤い石の結晶。擦り合わせると火花が飛ぶほど発火性が高いので、子供に持たせるのはちょっと危ない

desc.en: Effect: Increases necessary Search Equipment frames by 1. Item's effect increases by a small amount in exchange.
desc.ja: 効果：探索装備の装備枠を１つ増やす。代わりに、アイテムの効果が少し上昇する
